text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍۢ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that resumes the prior return statement and launches the first negation panel

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: connector plus negator opening the panel

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as a connected continuation, not as an isolated warning. It carries the prior return statement into a direct no-escape verdict, then helps establish the repeated {{ar:وَمَا}} ({{tr:wa-mā}}) openings that pair the escape-denial panel with the later aid-denial panel.

topics.headline: opening link carries return into no-escape verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the no-escape claim follows directly from the prior return to God, rather than beginning as a detached topic.
topics.reason: QAC tags the word as a conjunction and the first clause is a linked negated nominal predication, so the row family coherently preserves resumption and coordination.

topics.headline: repeated wa-mā openings pair the two panels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah shaped as two matched negation panels: first failed escape, then absent aid.
topics.reason: The opening connector-plus-negator recurs at the second panel, and attachment evidence separates the ayah into two coordinated nominal clauses.

words.gloss_range: negative particle in a reinforced nominal predicate frame, not interrogative or relative
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) begins the first panel as a nominal negation: the addressees are denied the predicate class itself. The following reinforced predicate selects the negative value of the particle and blocks interrogative or relative readings, so the clause denies a standing capacity to frustrate or escape across the coming locatives.

topics.headline: mā opens a reinforced nominal denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first denial is a predicate-state denial, not a finite-verb report about one attempted escape.
topics.reason: The construction is parsed as negation with an explicit subject and a bāʾ-governed predicate, matching the row claim.

topics.headline: particle range narrows to negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that a formally flexible particle is made precise by the local predicate construction.
topics.reason: The broader particle range is valid background, but the local sequence fixes negative force.

words.gloss_range: independent second-person masculine plural pronoun foregrounding the addressees as the subject of the denied capacity
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْتُمْ}} ({{tr:antum}}) makes the addressees grammatically visible before the denied predicate appears. The independent plural pronoun turns the first panel into direct confrontation: the same audience just told of return is now placed as subject and denied the standing identity of successful frustrators. Context points to the addressed disbelievers, while the open second-person form can still carry the warning beyond that immediate group.

topics.headline: explicit plural subject receives the denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial lands on an explicit you, not on an implied or generic subject.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is the subject of the negated nominal sentence, and the predicate attachment confirms the local role.

topics.headline: nominal clause denies a standing identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the wording removes a capacity-state, not merely one momentary act of resistance.
topics.reason: The pronoun stands in a verbless clause with a participial predicate, preserving the identity or capacity reading.

topics.headline: direct addressee is contextual but extendable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the immediate addressee in view while recognizing why the second-person warning can still feel broadly addressed.
topics.reason: The local discourse addresses the preceding audience, so universal application is kept as extension rather than the primary referent.

words.gloss_range: reinforcing predicate bāʾ in the negative construction, visibly attached to the participial predicate
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is not a locative or instrumental preposition here. It is the reinforcing predicate particle in the negated nominal frame, governing the following participle and tightening the denial. Its visible attachment to the predicate makes the denied class sound and look bound into the negation.

topics.headline: bāʾ tightens the negated predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that grammar itself intensifies the denial of the predicate class.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the particle as governing the predicate in the negative construction.

topics.headline: attachment image survives as binding pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the predicate bound to the negation, while not mistaking the particle for a real spatial phrase.
topics.reason: The base attachment value is only a secondary pressure because local grammar selects bāʾ al-zāʾida in the predicate frame.

words.gloss_range: Form IV active participle denying the addressees' capacity to elude, frustrate, or render the divine purpose incapable
words.root_gloss_range: weakness, inability, rearwardness, and causative incapacitating; local Form IV selects failed counter-agency and escape/frustration denial
words.prose: {{ar:مُعْجِزِينَ}} ({{tr:muʿjizīna}}) is the first panel's key denied class. As a Form IV active participle, it casts the addressees as would-be agents who might make the divine purpose fail, outrun it, or render it incapable, then denies that role. The participial form makes this a durable capacity-denial, and the earth-sky locatives spread that denial across created space. The familiar no-escape formula seen at 42:31 and 46:32 is made local here by that spatial expansion. After the prior return statement, the word blocks the imagined counter-motion: no one can turn the return back or leave it behind, and its constricted consonant texture reinforces that resistance only as a secondary cue.

topics.headline: Form IV denies causative counter-agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word denies more than flight; it denies the attempt to make the divine agent unable.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the surface as a Form IV active participle, and the local predicate relation licenses the counter-agency denial.

topics.headline: escape and frustration senses both matter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both sides of the lexeme in view: no eluding reach and no frustrating power.
topics.reason: The local no-escape context supports both elusion and frustration without forcing one to erase the other.

topics.headline: participle makes a stable denied class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressees denied a standing type or capacity, not only a single event.
topics.reason: The active participle is the predicate of the negated nominal clause and is governed by the reinforcing particle.

topics.headline: formulaic no-escape predicate expands into earth and sky
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a familiar no-escape formula made local by its earth-sky spatial expansion.
topics.reason: The predicate is followed by two locative complements, and contextual evidence supports the formulaic distribution of this root in no-escape settings.

topics.headline: return-boundary pressure and sound texture support the denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the word answer the prior return by denying any counter-motion, while sound texture remains a secondary cue.
topics.reason: The discourse boundary is strong, while phonetic texture is supportive rather than governing the lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: first locative preposition governing the earth phrase and beginning the spatial distribution of denied escape
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) turns the denied capacity into a located claim. The first locative phrase places failed escape in the earth-domain before the repeated preposition gives the sky its own parallel scope. Its attachment may be read narrowly with the predicate or broadly over the clause, but either way the payoff is concrete spatial containment rather than an abstract topic marker.

topics.headline: first fī locates the no-escape claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that escape-denial is mapped onto a real domain, beginning with earth.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle as a locative preposition governing the earth noun.

topics.headline: attachment ambiguity keeps two compatible scopes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear either the predicate or the whole denial earth-scoped without changing the no-escape force.
topics.reason: The guardrail evidence forces the prepositional complement relation but does not require only one semantic scope.

topics.headline: repeated fī starts the earth-sky merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same locative frame applied to both lower and upper domains.
topics.reason: The same preposition recurs before both coordinated locatives, preserving parallel distribution.

words.gloss_range: definite lower-world domain governed by the first locative preposition and paired with the sky as a comprehensive spatial merism
words.root_gloss_range: ground, land, earth, territory, settled lower domain; local sky contrast selects the broad lower-realm sense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite upper-domain noun paired with earth

words.prose: {{ar:الْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) names the first domain where escape is denied. Its definite singular form treats the earth as a known total lower realm, not a random patch of land, and its pairing with {{ar:السَّمَاءِ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾi}}) creates the lower pole of a cosmic enclosure. The ground/territory range remains concrete, while the sky contrast broadens it to the whole lower world. The same earth-domain is a repeated stage in this surah for signs, movement, creation, possession, and provision (29:20, 29:39, 29:56, 29:61, 29:63), so the no-escape domain is also a domain of divine action.

topics.headline: earth supplies the lower pole of total space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the no-escape claim begin as total spatial enclosure, from lower realm toward upper realm.
topics.reason: The earth noun is coordinated with the sky noun under repeated locative phrases, licensing the merism.

topics.headline: definite genitive earth is a governed domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording marks earth as one bounded domain inside the denial.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun definite and genitive under the preposition, matching the domain claim.

topics.headline: earth belongs to the surah's movement and sign field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied escape-domain is also a repeated surah setting for signs, movement, creation, and provision.
topics.reason: The same-surah recurrence rows are concrete and compatible with the local locative domain.

topics.headline: ground sense survives inside broader lower-world scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the concrete ground image while allowing the sky contrast to widen the word to the full lower realm.
topics.reason: The root range is broader than bare ground here because the coordinated sky phrase selects a cosmic lower-versus-upper contrast.

words.gloss_range: coordinator that joins a full second negative locative phrase to the first locative domain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: connector plus negator extending the denial

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the sky phrase to the earth phrase without making the sky a mere noun appended to earth. Because the connector is followed by a renewed negator and preposition, it builds a full second locative denial. The same {{ar:وَلَا}} ({{tr:wa-lā}}) cadence returns near the end of the ayah, so the spatial extension and aid-category extension answer each other.

topics.headline: wa coordinates a full second locative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second domain is fully coordinated under the same denial, not loosely appended.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the earth and sky nouns as conjoined in parallel locative phrases.

topics.headline: wa-lā extension recurs across panels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a repeated extension device: not in earth nor sky, then no patron nor helper.
topics.reason: The surface sequence recurs before the final denied aid noun, matching the row's local cadence claim.

words.gloss_range: negative particle extending the first negation to the sky phrase, not a prohibitive particle
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) blocks a sky-domain exception. The following preposition, not a jussive verb, selects ordinary negation rather than prohibition, so the phrase means that the denial extends upward as well. Its recurrence before the final helper noun ties the last spatial route and the last aid category into the same negative cascade.

topics.headline: lā extends negation to the sky domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second spatial domain explicitly denied rather than merely implied.
topics.reason: The particle precedes a prepositional phrase coordinated with the first locative, extending the initial negation.

topics.headline: following preposition blocks command force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids misreading the particle as a command; it is a negative extension of the no-escape claim.
topics.reason: The local complement is a prepositional phrase, not a jussive verb.

topics.headline: lā reprise links spatial and aid panels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same negating pulse shut down upper escape and final help.
topics.reason: The particle recurs before the final aid noun in the second panel, creating a local echo.

words.gloss_range: repeated locative preposition governing the sky noun and giving the upper domain its own full frame
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) is repeated before the sky noun instead of being left implicit. That repetition gives the upper domain its own governed locative frame, equal to the earth phrase, and keeps the sky from becoming a vague metaphor or afterthought. One denied predicate is distributed separately over two spaces.

topics.headline: repeated fī gives sky its own governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sky is independently framed under the same locative denial.
topics.reason: The particle is repeated and governs the sky noun in a syntactically forced prepositional complement.

topics.headline: sky remains a concrete domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats the upper realm as a real denied domain, not merely as an abstract concern.
topics.reason: The governed noun is the concrete sky noun, selecting spatial containment.

topics.headline: repetition distributes one denial over two locations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the two locations balanced by identical prepositional framing.
topics.reason: The same prepositional form introduces both coordinated domains.

words.gloss_range: definite upper-domain noun governed by the repeated locative preposition and closing the first panel's spatial enclosure
words.root_gloss_range: height, upperness, sky, canopy, what is above; local earth contrast selects elevation and upper-domain sense while naming-related etymology remains only background
words.prose: {{ar:السَّمَاءِ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾi}}) closes the first panel at the upper limit. Paired with the earth noun, it supplies the high pole of the merism, while its sky/canopy range makes the upper expanse part of the enclosure rather than an exit. Root-family links to naming are only background here; the local form and earth contrast keep the sense spatial and elevated. The same upper domain later appears as the source of punishment in 29:34, and the final glottal catch gives this beat a sharp audible stop before the aid-denial panel begins.

topics.headline: sky closes the spatial no-escape frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first panel finish at the highest named spatial domain before the ayah turns to aid.
topics.reason: The noun is the second coordinated locative complement in the earth-sky pair.

topics.headline: height and canopy image make upperness enclosing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the upper realm as something above and covering, not as a route outside the denial.
topics.reason: The lexical range supports sky, canopy, and what is above, and local syntax selects it as a concrete spatial domain.

topics.headline: naming etymology remains secondary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not let possible naming-related background displace the visible sky-domain role.
topics.reason: The surface form is the concrete sky noun and the coordinated earth phrase selects elevation, so naming is retained only as background pressure.

topics.headline: earth-sky formula joins wider and local fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a Quran-wide creation pair turned here into no-escape rhetoric, with later same-surah sky references reinforcing divine control.
topics.reason: The row references are concrete and compatible with the local merism and same-surah field.

topics.headline: beat-final sound reinforces closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first panel land sharply at the upper domain before the second panel begins.
topics.reason: The beat-final position is structural; the phonetic claim is supportive rather than a lexical determinant.

words.gloss_range: panel-opening conjunction that coordinates the second negation while pivoting from escape-denial to aid-denial

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: connector plus negator opening the second panel

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the second panel while keeping it tied to the first. The ayah now pivots from where the addressees cannot escape to what they do not possess: no alternative support. The repeated {{ar:وَمَا}} ({{tr:wa-mā}}) onset makes the two halves sound matched even as the syntax changes from predicate-denial to existential possession-denial.

topics.headline: wa pivots from escape denial to aid denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah move from blocked agency to blocked dependency without breaking the argument.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second nominal clause as coordinated with the first, and the particle opens that clause.

topics.headline: wa-mā anaphora pairs the panel openings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two negation panels as matched verdicts before parsing their different internal frames.
topics.reason: The same connector-plus-negator onset appears at both major panel openings.

words.gloss_range: second negative particle in an existential possession frame, denying available alternative support
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) now works differently from the first panel's particle. With the following for-you phrase and the later universalizing particle before the patron noun, it creates a verbless existential frame: there is no alternative support available for the addressees. The same particle shape therefore pairs the panels while the syntax shifts from denied capacity to denied possession.

topics.headline: second mā denies possession of support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second half does not repeat the first denial; it removes any support available to the addressees.
topics.reason: The construction is a compressed existential possession frame with delayed denied nouns.

topics.headline: same particle, different syntactic frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears structural anaphora while seeing the grammar change from predicate denial to existence denial.
topics.reason: The two clauses both begin with the same particle but have different attachment structures.

topics.headline: negation covers both patron and helper
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the whole alternative aid field evaluated as absent outside God.
topics.reason: The negation scopes over the coordinated patron and helper nouns within the same existential frame.

words.gloss_range: prepositional lām with attached second-person plural suffix, forming the for-you possession/specification frame
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}), with its attached plural suffix, personalizes the second panel. The wording does not merely say that support is absent in the abstract; it says no such support is for you. The bound suffix carries the same addressed group from the independent pronoun into the possession frame, and the denied patron and helper nouns are delayed until after that lack is assigned to them. Its compressed preposition-suffix form and nasal handoff into the exclusion phrase make the move from for-you to apart-from-God feel tightly joined.

topics.headline: for-you frame assigns the lack to the addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the aid-denial is personally allocated to the addressees, not stated abstractly.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the plural suffix and functions as the fronted predicate of the existential construction.

topics.headline: attached suffix carries the same audience forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same you from the first panel reappear in bound form in the second panel.
topics.reason: The suffix is second-person masculine plural and matches the explicit pronoun in the first panel.

topics.headline: fronted for-you phrase delays the aid nouns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the shift from place-of-escape language to possession-of-support language before the support terms are named.
topics.reason: The fronted prepositional phrase precedes the denied nouns and marks the second panel's possessive frame.

topics.headline: compressed form binds possession to exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the for-you phrase move tightly into the besides-God exclusion phrase.
topics.reason: The fused form is morphologically real; sound linkage is supportive rather than the main syntactic claim.

words.gloss_range: first min in the second panel, forming the apart-from-God exclusion phrase with the following noun
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) begins the exclusion phrase, not the later zero-instance quantifier. With the following exclusion noun it forms the compact besides-God frame, routing the aid-denial through a boundary: no support comes from any source apart from God. The compact nasal-to-stop transition makes the exclusion phrase sound like a tight unit. The identical surface later before the patron noun is re-parsed by its neighbor, so the panel uses the same small form for two different jobs.

topics.headline: first min forms the apart-from-God frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the aid-denial is measured against an exclusion boundary, not merely against quantity.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following exclusion noun in a compound prepositional expression.

topics.headline: identical min tokens split into two functions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the compact second panel distinguish source-exclusion from zero-instance denial.
topics.reason: The first particle is followed by the exclusion noun, while the second is followed by an indefinite support noun.

topics.headline: compound form and sound tighten the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the exclusion phrase as a tight unit while keeping grammar as the main basis for the reading.
topics.reason: The compound expression is syntactically licensed; phonetic compression is secondary support.

words.gloss_range: relational exclusion noun in the besides-God phrase, carrying apartness and below/short-of hierarchy
words.root_gloss_range: below, beneath, short of, apart from, other than; local phrase selects exclusion while retaining lower-than pressure
words.prose: {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}) is the word that turns the second panel into a boundary claim. It is governed by the preceding particle and governs the divine name after it, so every later support noun is measured from outside or short of that reference point. The lowness/short-of image gives hierarchy to the exclusion, while unrelated derivative fields remain background rather than the selected local sense. The same besides-God field appears around worship, love, and false protectors in this surah (29:17, 29:25, 29:41, 29:42), while here it is narrowed to absent aid; the slowed phrase center at the divine name reinforces that boundary.

topics.headline: dūn marks the outside-God boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that alternative aid is denied from a defined relational zone outside or short of God.
topics.reason: The compound phrase and genitive complement make the divine name the reference point of exclusion.

topics.headline: below and short-of pressure adds hierarchy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels alternative recourse as not only different from God but lower and unable to cross the boundary.
topics.reason: The lexical range includes below, short of, and apart from; local syntax selects exclusion while preserving hierarchy.

topics.headline: formula concentrates failed alternative recourse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a recurring besides-God formula narrowed here to the absence of protector and helper.
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah and formula rows align with the local aid-denial structure.

topics.headline: derivative disputes do not replace apartness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the selected exclusion sense clear while allowing debated root neighborhoods only as distant pressure.
topics.reason: The surface form is the abstract exclusion noun, not an administrative derivative or an obligation term.

topics.headline: sound slows at the divine boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the exclusion phrase gather around the divine reference point, while syntax remains the controlling evidence.
topics.reason: The sound observation supports a phrase boundary already licensed by grammar.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name completing the exclusion phrase and serving as the reference point against which all alternative support is denied
words.root_gloss_range: divinity, worship, refuge, perplexed turning; local proper-name form fixes the specific divine reference rather than a generic deity class
words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes the besides-God phrase and becomes the second panel's hinge. The proper name fixes the reference point: after it, every possible patron or helper outside that reference is negated. Devotion and refuge associations sharpen why alternatives fail, but the proper-name form keeps the phrase specific rather than generic. Its direct liaison with the exclusion word makes the boundary audible, and the surah's repeated divine-reference framework keeps this name as the governing reference for the denial.

topics.headline: proper name anchors the exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial of alternative support is measured from a fixed divine reference point.
topics.reason: The divine name is the genitive complement of the exclusion noun and anchors the formula.

topics.headline: proper-name form blocks generic deity reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the phrase names God specifically, not an abstract deity category.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a proper noun, and the exclusion phrase is built around that proper name.

topics.headline: refuge and devotion field sharpens failed alternatives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels why vanishing protectors leave only the divine refuge point, while not turning the proper name into a root gloss.
topics.reason: Root-field evidence is relevant as pressure, but local grammar selects the proper divine name in the formula.

topics.headline: divine name stands between exclusion and void
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the divine name placed before the support nouns, so all alternatives are denied after the reference point is named.
topics.reason: The word completes the formula and precedes the denied patron and helper nouns in the panel.

topics.headline: surah repetition and liaison support the hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the exclusion phrase joined tightly to the divine name while the surah's repeated divine reference remains in view.
topics.reason: The same-surah repetition is concrete and the liaison supports an already clear construct relation.

words.gloss_range: second min in the second panel, a negation-strengthening quantifier before the indefinite patron noun
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) has a different job from the earlier exclusion particle. Here, before the indefinite patron noun and under negation, it makes the denial zero-instance: not any patron whatsoever. After the mercy statement in 29:21, that quantification matters: no alternate patron can replace divine mercy. The repeated particle shape keeps the panel compact, while the neighboring noun distinguishes quantity from the earlier besides-God boundary, and the nasal contact with the patron noun binds the not-any force to that noun.

topics.headline: second min universalizes the patron denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording denies even one instance of the patron category.
topics.reason: The particle precedes an indefinite support noun under negation and governs it in the existential frame.

topics.headline: same form contrasts exclusion and quantity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes the first particle's apart-from function from the second particle's not-any function.
topics.reason: The second token is followed by the patron noun rather than the exclusion noun.

topics.headline: sound binds quantifier to noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the quantifier and patron noun as a tight denial unit while keeping syntax as the controlling evidence.
topics.reason: The direct preposed relation is syntactically forced; sound is a secondary cue.

topics.headline: quantified patron-denial answers sovereign mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior divine mercy answered by the quantified absence of any alternative patron.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the local quantified denial of patronage.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular patron/protector noun under negation, denying any relational guardian, patron, or authority outside God
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, adjacency, following, alliance, patronage, guardianship, authority, taking charge; local pairing with helper selects relational protection rather than active rescue

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final active-helper noun coordinated with patron

words.prose: {{ar:وَلِيٍّ}} ({{tr:waliyyin}}) is the first denied aid category. Its indefinite singular form after the quantifying particle denies even one patron, and its root-field of nearness, loyalty, and taking charge makes the loss relational: no close guardian or protective authority remains outside God. Its durable relational shape and geminated ending make the denied closeness feel compact rather than momentary. Its position before {{ar:نَصِيرٍ}} ({{tr:naṣīrin}}) matters because patronal nearness is denied before active rescue, and the later false-protector image in 29:41 exposes the same failed category in plural form.

topics.headline: indefinite singular denies any patron
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse denies the patron category at its smallest instance, not merely a known patron.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite singular and governed by the quantifying particle under negation.

topics.headline: nearness grounds patronal authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that what is denied is protective nearness and taking-charge authority, not generic strength.
topics.reason: The root range supports nearness and guardianship, and the following helper noun distinguishes this relational category from active rescue.

topics.headline: patronage precedes active rescue in the aid pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pair is not redundant: relational protection is denied before operational help.
topics.reason: The patron noun is coordinated with the helper noun, and the row evidence supports the formulaic distinction.

topics.headline: singular lack anticipates exposed false protectors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the singular categorical lack in 29:22 prepare for the plural false-protector image in 29:41.
topics.reason: The row gives concrete same-surah references, and the singular/plural contrast is compatible with the local form.

topics.headline: durable form and compressed sound support relational role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the denied patron as a stable relation, with sound compression supporting rather than controlling the reading.
topics.reason: The noun's relational role is lexically and grammatically supported; phonetic compression is secondary.

words.gloss_range: coordinator before the final negative particle, adding the helper category under the same possession denial

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: connector plus negator adding the final aid category

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the helper noun without restarting the clause. It coordinates the final aid category with the patron noun under the same negated possession frame, so the two support modes remain joined but distinct. By forming another {{ar:وَلَا}} ({{tr:wa-lā}}) extension, it also reprises the earlier spatial pattern: one more domain or category is shut down.

topics.headline: wa coordinates helper with patron under one frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patron and helper are coordinated support modes, not two disconnected clauses.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final helper noun as conjoined with the patron noun.

topics.headline: final wa-lā adds the second aid category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final extension mirror the earlier spatial extension while adding the last support category.
topics.reason: The same connector-plus-negator shape appears in both panel-internal extensions.

words.gloss_range: negative particle extending the aid-denial to the helper noun, not a prohibitive particle
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) prevents active rescue from surviving as a fallback after patronage has been denied. The following noun selects pure negation, not prohibition, so the phrase means no helper, not do not help. Its parallel with the earlier sky-denial makes the final category feel like the aid-panel counterpart to the last spatial domain.

topics.headline: lā blocks a remaining helper fallback
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that after patronage is denied, active rescue is also explicitly removed.
topics.reason: The particle precedes the coordinated helper noun inside the same negated existential frame.

topics.headline: following noun selects nominal negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids hearing command force where the grammar gives a noun phrase denial.
topics.reason: The following word is a noun, not a jussive verb, so prohibitive parsing is blocked.

topics.headline: negative reprise links sky and helper denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same negative particle close the last spatial domain and the last support category.
topics.reason: The same particle appears in the spatial extension and the final aid extension.

words.gloss_range: singular indefinite intensive helper/rescuer noun coordinated with the denied patron and closing the ayah on active-help denial
words.root_gloss_range: help, support, rescue, victory, effective aid; local pairing with patron selects operational intervention and reliable helper-by-nature force
words.prose: {{ar:نَصِيرٍ}} ({{tr:naṣīrin}}) is the ayah's closing support term. It shares the genitive indefinite frame with the patron noun, so it remains coordinated under the same denial, but its root and intensive form move from protective nearness to active rescue and effective aid. Even the help-seeking pathway is narrowed to this surface noun: no appeal would find such a helper. The final position matters: after no escape in earth or sky and no patron outside God, the ayah lands on no reliable helper, not even one whose defining trait would be support. The familiar patron-helper denial formula seen at 2:107, 9:116, and 42:31 is concentrated here, and the same no-help motif continues nearby in 29:25. Its shared indefinite cadence with the patron noun and long-vowel resonance back to the opening denied escape class make the two panels audible as a frame.

topics.headline: case and indefiniteness lock helper to patron denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun denies even one helper inside the same support frame as the patron noun.
topics.reason: The final noun is indefinite and genitive by coordination with the patron noun under negation.

topics.headline: helper names operational rescue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes active rescue and victory-help from the preceding patronal nearness.
topics.reason: The helper noun is coordinated after the patron noun, and the lexical field supports operational aid.

topics.headline: intensive form denies reliable helper-by-nature
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial reach a characterized helper, not merely someone who happens to help once.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an intensive adjective/noun form, and the rows compare it with simpler helper forms.

topics.headline: help-seeking derivative colors the denied pathway
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses that any appeal for support would find no answering helper, while the surface word remains the helper noun.
topics.reason: The derivative is not the surface form, so it is retained only as root-family pressure.

topics.headline: formulaic helper denial echoes across and within the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the patron-helper doublet as a familiar total-aid formula, with nearby same-surah help forms keeping the motif active.
topics.reason: The formula and same-surah rows provide concrete references and align with the local coordinated pair.

topics.headline: final helper denial seals the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah close by removing the last external recourse after self-escape has already been removed.
topics.reason: The noun is the final word and is coordinated with the aid-denial pair after the no-escape panel.

topics.headline: cadence pairs patron, helper, and escape terms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final helper noun rhyme back to the patron and earlier escape predicate, while sound remains supportive.
topics.reason: The shared indefinite cadence and final position are observable, but they do not override syntax or lexical sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
baseline_models.mechanism: مُعْجِزِينَ casts evasion as gaining an unreachable lead, while earth below and sky above form an exhaustive vertical merism; no location supplies a successful head start or exit.

activation_trace.role: Falling beyond a pursuer's reach supplies the attempted escape, and the negation cancels that function.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the merism's terrestrial half.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper realm that completes the spatial totality.

changed_reading.before: A generic denial that the addressees can overpower.
changed_reading.after: A denial that they can outpace divine pursuit anywhere in the lower or upper domain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍۢ
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction removes every alternative to God, then distinguishes sustained charge or protective alignment from intervention that gives aid against opposition; neither support channel exists independently beside God.

activation_trace.role: Otherness or substitution supplies the excluded alternative position beside God.
The worshipped one supplies the exclusive relational center against which alternatives are denied.
Taking charge and standing over an affair supplies durable guardianship as the first denied support mode.
Aid that makes one prevail against an opponent supplies active rescue as the second denied support mode.

changed_reading.before: There is no ally or helper besides God.
changed_reading.after: No substitute can either carry the addressee's affairs continuously or intervene effectively when opposition arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier question whether wrongdoers can precede or escape God supplies the race that مُعْجِزِينَ later closes: accountability cannot be defeated by gaining time, distance, or a lead.

activation_trace.role: Getting away from a pursuer supplies the earlier attempted maneuver that 29:22 categorically denies.
Outrunning or eluding pursuit supplies the focus anchor that answers the earlier question.

structural_cues: 29:4 poses the outstripping question before 29:22 gives the categorical negation.
The two branch images share a pursuit-and-evasion frame rather than generic power language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two images of escaping a pursuer; I read the later negation as answering the earlier question. A live alternative is simple precedence in 29:4, but its escape branch makes the race linkage unusually tight.

changed_reading.after: The verse answers the wrongdoer's imagined race: no early lead, delay, or distance can put accountability behind them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Actual divine extraction from fire and the direct petition for victory show that the focus does not announce a help-less universe; it denies autonomous help outside God and redirects the request to its effective source.

activation_trace.role: Release by separation supplies a concrete rescue from the threatened fire.
The divine name identifies the rescuer and fixes the rescue's source.
A direct request for aid against opponents makes the focus noun's active assistance operational.
Aid and prevailing assistance supply the focus category whose independent alternatives are denied.

structural_cues: 29:24 explicitly attributes Abraham's rescue to God.
29:30 addresses the request for نصر to the Lord rather than to an alternative patron.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine rescue and a direct divine petition; I infer that the focus negates independent sources, not the occurrence of rescue. A narrower eschatological-only reading remains possible, but the surrounding rescues broaden the functional field.

changed_reading.before: No helper is available besides God.
changed_reading.after: Effective help is real as divine extraction and support; what is impossible is an independent rescue channel outside God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Substitute worship is maintained as affection connecting a group in worldly life, but the same network reverses into mutual repudiation, expulsion, and the absence of supporters; the focus denial thus exposes a patronage coalition whose bonds invert under judgment.

activation_trace.role: The alternative beside God locates the coalition in the very substitute position denied by the focus.
Affection supplies the bond that temporarily holds the substitute network together.
A connection standing between parties supplies the network's social linkage.
Expulsion under anger reverses the earlier affection into an anti-protective relation.
The final absence of supporters states the coalition's failure to become effective aid.
Love, alliance, and mutual aid supply the focus relation that the later social reversal tests.

structural_cues: 29:25 places worldly affection and final mutual cursing in one explicit temporal sequence.
The repeated بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍ makes the reversal reciprocal before the verse ends with no supporters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a worldly bond, its reciprocal reversal, and failed support; I treat these as stages of one patronage network. The idols are the overt objects, while the verse's بَيْنِكُمْ keeps the human coalition materially live.

changed_reading.before: No protective ally or helper exists besides God.
changed_reading.after: Alternative patronage can look socially cohesive for a time, yet its own bonds reverse direction and leave every member unsupported.

context_deltas.mechanism: Taking protectors is rendered as constructing a dwelling: the spider genuinely builds and occupies a house, yet the structure is the weakest shelter. Substitute patronage is therefore not merely missing but materially misbuilt for the load of protection placed on it.

activation_trace.role: Otherness supplies the alternative placement outside God.
Assuming charge over an affair supplies the protective function assigned to the chosen patrons.
The web-spinning creature supplies an active maker whose construction nevertheless cannot bear protective weight.
Dwelling and shelter give patronage a concrete architectural function.
Loss of strength supplies the structural failure of the supposed shelter.
Durable charge over one's affairs is the focus function that the weak-house image reconfigures.

structural_cues: 29:41 explicitly equates taking awliya besides God with a spider taking a house.
The simile preserves successful construction but denies protective adequacy, sharpening the kind of failure involved.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet itself supplies the patron-house simile; I infer that shelter is the functional bridge from house to protective charge. A broader reading as fragile religious or social organization remains compatible rather than excluded.

changed_reading.before: The addressees simply lack an alternative protector.
changed_reading.after: They may construct a substitute protection system, but it is a shelter whose internal material cannot carry the protective function assigned to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation of the heavens and earth, followed by God's sufficiency as witness and knowledge of everything within them, turns the focus merism from empty geography into authored, observed jurisdiction. There is no unowned or unseen corner from which to outstrip accountability.

activation_trace.role: Bringing creation into existence supplies authorship of both spatial domains.
The overhanging heavens supply the upper half of the authored jurisdiction.
The lower earth supplies the authored jurisdiction's terrestrial half.
Standing over an affair until sufficiency is achieved supplies God's complete evidentiary adequacy.
Presence with observation supplies witness across the disputed relation.
Disclosure to the knower removes the possibility of an unseen refuge.
Attempted evasion remains the focus action now blocked by authored and observed jurisdiction.

structural_cues: 29:44 coordinates heavens and earth as a single created pair.
29:52 repeats the same pair as the full field of divine knowledge while naming God sufficient witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorship, witnessing, and knowledge over the same merism; I infer that these jointly eliminate unowned and unseen refuge. The focus may stress raw power more than surveillance, but the witness sequence adds a real epistemic layer.

changed_reading.before: Earth and sky exhaust the places where escape might be attempted.
changed_reading.after: Earth and sky are an authored and fully witnessed jurisdiction, so escape cannot exploit either an unowned zone or an observational blind spot.

context_deltas.mechanism: Punishment descends from the sky, the earth opens downward, and the final scene is already encompassing before it covers from above and beneath the feet. The focus coordinates become active delivery surfaces of reckoning rather than neutral places in which one might hide.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to descend and reach its destination supplies the sky-to-ground delivery vector.
The overhanging sky supplies a source direction for the descending affliction.
The earth's sinking supplies a downward mode of seizure.
The lower realm becomes an instrument that engulfs rather than a refuge.
Encompassment by domination and destruction supplies enclosure already in force.
A covering that generalizes over its objects supplies the enclosing event's contact.
The upper direction supplies one face of the closing vertical field.
The underside beneath the feet supplies the opposing face, leaving no vertical gap.

structural_cues: 29:34 makes the sky a source of descent, while 29:40 makes the earth a mode of engulfment.
29:54 says the enclosure already surrounds; 29:55 then renders it as cover from above and beneath the feet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, sinking, prior encompassment, and two-sided vertical cover; I read these episodes as unpacking the focus merism into active vectors. They can also stand as separate judgment scenes, but their repeated geometry preserves the linkage.

changed_reading.before: Neither earth nor sky offers a place of escape.
changed_reading.after: The very domains sought as refuge can deliver, engulf, and close around the fugitive from above and below.

context_deltas.mechanism: God's earth is explicitly spacious and paired with the command to worship Him, so the focus denial is not spatial claustrophobia or a ban on relocation. Horizontal movement remains ample, but no movement crosses out of divine allegiance and jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: The terrestrial domain supplies the same focus arena, now marked as God's own earth.
Expanse opposed to constriction supplies genuine room for relocation within the domain.
Submissive worship supplies the purpose that distinguishes faithful movement from evasive flight.
Escape from pursuit supplies the prohibited movement type, contrasted with permitted relocation.

structural_cues: 29:56 joins possessive أَرْضِى, spatial breadth, and exclusive worship in one compact command.
The broad earth follows the focus denial without retracting it, forcing a distinction between mobility and escape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies breadth within God's earth and an exclusive worship imperative; I infer that relocation can serve obedience without becoming metaphysical evasion. The verse may specifically license migration, which strengthens rather than exhausts this distinction.

changed_reading.before: No escape on earth can sound like total spatial confinement.
changed_reading.after: There is abundant room to move faithfully within God's earth, but no route turns relocation into exit from His claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The substitutes worshipped beside God do not own or dispose of provision, while creatures unable to carry their own allotment are fed by God. The denied wali and nasir therefore include ordinary maintenance and supply, not only emergency intervention or combat aid.

activation_trace.role: The repeated alternative position beside God marks the proposed providers as substitutes.
Ownership with power of disposal supplies the capacity explicitly denied to the substitutes.
An apportioned gift supplies the concrete good the substitutes cannot provide and seekers must request from God.
Carrying a visible load supplies the creature's inability to transport its own provision.
Sustaining food supplies the recurring support that God provides to dependent creatures.
The divine name fixes the source of the provision that dependents cannot carry for themselves.
Standing over another's affairs supplies the durable support function broadened into maintenance.
Effective aid supplies the help category extended from conflict into material dependence.

structural_cues: 29:17 repeats مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ while denying the idols ownership of provision.
29:60 reverses inability to carry provision into God's ongoing act of provisioning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed substitute ownership and divine maintenance of non-carrying creatures; I map provision onto the practical work of guardianship and aid. A narrower legal or martial sense of wali/nasir remains live, so this broadening stays medium-confidence.

changed_reading.before: Wali and nasir concern protection or victory in moments of conflict.
changed_reading.after: Their denied substitute function also reaches the quiet infrastructure of survival: no alternative owns or reliably carries one's provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's split س م م inventory rather than the ordinary س م و sky branch. It remains anchored to the exact focus sky occurrence and is sharpened by punishment descending from the sky in 29:34; downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant aperture analogy, never as the lexical sense of سَمَاء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ at 29:22, reactivated by مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ at 29:34

activation_trace.role: A narrow opening through which something enters supplies an exploratory ingress image for the focus sky.
The same packet-authorized split branch turns the contextual sky into a possible opening rather than an escape expanse.
Delivery by descent supplies the directional event that makes the aperture image functionally relevant.

changed_reading.before: The sky is imagined as an open upper region into which one might flee.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the upper region is not an exit but an ingress through which reckoning can be delivered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because نَصِير normally evokes a personal helper, yet the focus inventory itself carries a rain-and-relief branch and 29:63 explicitly joins sky-water-earth revival with God. Downstream prose should qualify it as an ecological branch activation, not replace the ordinary agency sense of nasir with a dictionary claim about rain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَصِيرٍ at 29:22 within the surah's sky-water-earth revival sequence

activation_trace.role: Rain that relieves and makes land grow supplies an ecological image of effective help.
The sky as cloud and rain-bearing upper cover supplies the source domain of the relief.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the material means of the help.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the restorative effect.
The fertile, planted earth supplies the recipient whose revival makes rain function as aid.

changed_reading.before: A nasir is imagined only as an agent who intervenes against an opponent.
changed_reading.after: The help denied to alternatives can also be pictured, without displacing the ordinary sense, as life-restoring relief moving from sky to earth.

strongest_changes: The earlier attempt to outstrip God turns مُعْجِزِينَ into the answer to a failed race, not merely a generic lack of power.
Concrete rescues and direct petitions show that help is exclusive to God rather than absent from the world.
Worldly affection, mutual cursing, and the spider house expose substitute patronage as both reversible social linkage and structurally inadequate shelter.
Creation, witness, descending punishment, engulfing earth, and above-below enclosure make earth and sky an authored, observed, active jurisdiction.
The spaciousness of God's earth separates legitimate relocation from impossible evasion.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation converted a flat spatial warning into interacting pursuit, rescue, coalition, shelter, jurisdiction, and provision mechanisms, while the split sky inventory and rain branch preserved two contained readings that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether earth-sky primarily marks exhaustive extent or actively instrumental geography; the surah supports both.
Whether wali and nasir are chiefly eschatological, legal-social, or broadly practical support terms; context widens them without erasing the narrower senses.
The sky-aperture activation is packet-authorized but form-distant and must remain explicitly analogical.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **No geography of elusion.** ع ج ز B002 is “escape, outstripping, and eluding pursuit,” alongside B001's inability. Earth and sky exhaust the imagined search-space, and absence of patron or helper removes relational escape. I infer that evasion requires either an outside territory or an effective ally; by denying both, the ayah reads “not causing failure” as total non-eludability rather than mere weakness.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:67's secure sanctuary might appear to be a local exception, but its safety is explicitly made by God amid surrounding seizure. It confirms that protection is granted within the inescapable domain, not an escape from it.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Incapacity is specifically failure to elude pursuit across the full vertical field.** Lexical evidence: `بِمُعْجِزِينَ`, root `ع ج ز`, `B002` (escape, outstripping, and eluding pursuit); `ٱلْأَرْض`, root `ء ر ض`, `B001` (lower ground opposite the sky); and `ٱلسَّمَاء`, root `س م و`, `B004` (overhead sky and cover). Structural cue: earth and sky are joined by repeated negation after `29:20-21` asserted effective capacity and reversal. Assigned role: the paired regions close horizontal and vertical escape routes; `ع ج ز B002` defines the failed maneuver. Abductive move: the packet supplies exhaustive spatial opposition and denial; I infer that the target is imagined evasion, not generic inability to perform any act. Reading change: the ayah says the addressees cannot make themselves uncatchable anywhere in the created field.

2. **Nearer alternatives never reach the threshold of protective agency.** Lexical evidence: `مِن دُونِ`, root `د و ن`, `B001` (nearness short of a limit); `وَلِىّ`, root `و ل ي`, `B004` (loyal alliance and support); and `نَصِير`, root `ن ص ر`, `B001` (aid that makes someone prevail). Structural cue: `29:17` denied alternative providers, `29:21` centralized allocation, and `29:24-26` show rescue and migration oriented to God alone. Assigned role: other alliances may be socially near, but they fall short of effective protection and prevailing aid. Abductive move: “short of the limit” does not itself identify which limit; I infer from `ولي/نصير` that it is the threshold of effective rescue. Reading change: the denial concerns operational protection, not the mere existence of associates.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later correction (`29:41`, `29:56`):** The spider house gives a material model for allies that cannot protect, while the wide earth authorizes relocation for worship. Together they distinguish two claims in `29:22`: no region permits metaphysical evasion, yet earthly movement remains a valid response to failed local protection.

baseline.text: Siz ne yeryüzünde ne de gökte Allah'ı etkisiz bırakabilirsiniz. Allah'tan başka hiçbir koruyucunuz ve yardımcınız yoktur.

findings.text: Yeryüzü ile göğün birlikte anılması, kaçış için dışarıda bir bölge bırakmaz; “etkisiz bırakamama” burada her yerde takipten kurtulamamaktır.
Allah'tan başka yakın görünen bağlar, gerçek koruma ve üstün getiren yardım eşiğine hiçbir zaman ulaşamaz.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 (29:14-27) Manufactured Allegiance and Its Reversal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A cultic object becomes powerful through service, possession, affection, and alliance, then those same relations reverse into repudiation and expulsion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Idolatry appears less as a static object class than as a deliberately assembled social and property regime whose bonds later run backward.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Affection as an Alliance Contract
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Shared attachment to a cultic object binds parties through proximity, patronage, and a connective social compact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: affection and mutual love `quranic:root_001634:B001/m01`; Wadd as a named idol `quranic:root_001634:B005/m01`; loving and protective alliance `quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`; legal clientage `quranic:root_001684:B005/m01`; a connective relation between parties `quranic:root_000170:B003/m01`; taking and possessing an object `quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: "Affection among you" behaves like alliance infrastructure: proximity, protection, clientage, and possession gather around a shared object. Wadd's lexical identity as an idol sharpens the pun by making affection itself both bond and cultic name.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 (29:14-27) Manufactured Allegiance and Its Reversal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A cultic object becomes powerful through service, possession, affection, and alliance, then those same relations reverse into repudiation and expulsion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Idolatry appears less as a static object class than as a deliberately assembled social and property regime whose bonds later run backward.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Repudiation, Separation, and Expulsion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The alliance is disowned, its connective middle is cut, parties turn away, and each drives the other beyond protection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: repudiation and disavowal `quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`; separation after connection `quranic:root_000170:B001/m01`; irrevocable severance `quranic:root_000170:B012/m01`; turning away and abandoning proximity `quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`; expulsion under wrath `quranic:root_001359:B001/m01`; reciprocal imprecation `quranic:root_001359:B004/m01`; aid against an adversary `quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The eschatological reversal dismantles every relation that sustained the idol compact. Affection becomes mutual disavowal, connection becomes irrevocable separation, patronage becomes withdrawal, and blessing is replaced by reciprocal expulsion.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı bir şeyi yapacak güçten yoksun kalma, yetersiz kalma ve kararlı davranamama çevresinde kurar. Birini eylemden caydırma, onu yetersiz sayma ve erkek hayvanda çiftleşme gücünden yoksunluk da aynı çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, takip edilen birinin erişilemez olması veya bir şeyin arka bölümü anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel güç yetirememe çekirdeği ile caydırma, yetersiz sayma ve erkek hayvandaki çiftleşememe gibi biçime ya da söz öbeğine bağlı kullanımları ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi yapmaya gücü yetmemek, gereken yeterlikten geri kalmak ya da kararlı davranamamak. Bundan, birini eylemden alıkoyma veya yetersiz sayma ile erkek hayvanda çiftleşme gücünün bulunmaması gibi özel kullanımlar doğar.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi yapacak güce veya yeterli olanağa sahip olmama.
Gereken ölçüde kararlı davranamama ya da işi sürdürmede eksik kalma.
Birini isteksizleştirip eylemden alıkoyma veya onu yetersiz sayma.
Erkek hayvanın çiftleşmeye güç yetirememesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi güçsüzlük, yetersiz kalma ve eylemi gerçekleştirememe üzerindedir; kararlılık eksikliği, caydırma, yetersiz sayma ve çiftleşememe bunun özel görünümleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir eylemi gerçekleştirecek güç veya yeterliğin bulunmadığı genel çekirdeği karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Güç yokluğunu, eylem karşısındaki yetersizliği ve sonuçta geri kalmayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir işi yapma gücünün bulunmadığı cümlelerde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylem ile yetersiz özne arasındaki doğrudan ilişkiyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin eylemden alıkonduğu veya gücünün yetmediğinin ileri sürüldüğü türemiş kullanımlarda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem eylemi engelleme hem de yetersizlik yükleme yönlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Erkek insan veya hayvandaki cinsel güç yetersizliğini anlatan dar bağlamda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana çizgisi takip edilene yetişememe, onun öne geçmesi ve erişilemez olmasıdır. Yarışma, karşı koyma veya kaçabileceğini sanma yorumları bu çizginin bağlama bağlı çeşitleridir; güvenilen bir yere yönelme ise yalnız özel söz öbeğinde geçerli ayrı bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Erişilemez olma çekirdeği, öznenin genel güçsüzlüğüyle karıştırılmamalı; sığınağa yönelme kullanımı da bütün dala yayılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, takipten sıyrılma çekirdeğini biçime bağlı yarışma yorumlarından ve güvenilen bir yere yönelme söz öbeğinden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Takip edilenin uzaklaşıp öne geçmesi yüzünden arayanın ona yetişememesi veya onu ele geçirememesi. Bazı biçimlerde yarışma, karşı koyma ya da kaçabileceğini sanma anlatılır; belirli bir söz öbeğinde ise güvenilen bir yere yönelme anlamı bulunur.

facets.statement: Takip edilenin uzaklaşarak arayan için erişilemez olması.
Öne geçme nedeniyle takipçinin yetişememesi ve aradığını elden kaçırması.
Belirli bir biçimin yarışanlar, karşı koyanlar veya kaçabileceklerini sananlar olarak yorumlanması.
Yalnız belirli söz öbeğinde güvenilir sayılan bir sığınağa yönelme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, birinin uzaklaşıp takipçisinin erişiminden çıkmasıdır. Yarışma ve karşı koyma yorumları kaçış ilişkisini farklı açılardan kurar; güvenilir bir yere yönelme ise kalıba bağlı olarak ayrı tutulur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Takip edilenin öne geçerek veya uzaklaşarak arayanın erişiminden çıkmasını anlatan çekirdekte kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Takibi, taraflar arasındaki yönü, uzaklaşmayı ve erişilememe sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Anlatım takipçinin bakış açısından kurulduğunda ve aranan kişiye yetişilemediğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Takipçinin erişememesini ve arananın kaçması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Anlatım kaçan veya yarışan tarafın bakış açısından kurulduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Öne geçmeyi ve takipçinin erişiminden çıkmayı birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanlarda ileri yaşı ve yaşlanmayı açıkça doğrular; yıllanmış içki bu çekirdeğin eskilik uzantısıdır. Kılıç namlusu veya kabza parçasına verilen ad ise bir açıklamada eskiliğe bağlansa da adlandırmanın kendisi kesin olarak yalnız bu gerekçeye indirgenemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İnsan yaşlılığı ile nesne eskiliği bağlantılı tutulmalı, kılıç parçasının adı ise kesin bir eskilik örneği gibi genelleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım insanın yaşlılığı çekirdeğini, yıllanmış içki kullanımını ve kılıç parçasına özgü adlandırmayı birbirinden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Kadın veya erkeğin ileri yaşta olması ve bu duruma gelmesi; eskilik ilişkisiyle yıllanmış içkiye de aynı niteleme verilir. Kılıcın namlusu ya da kabzasındaki bir parça için kullanılan ad ise kaynaklarda yer alır, fakat eskilik bağı yalnız olası bir açıklamadır.

facets.statement: Kadın veya erkeğin ileri yaşta bulunması.
Bir kadının yaşlanarak ileri yaş durumuna gelmesi.
Uzun süre bekleyip yıllanmış içkinin eskilik yönüyle yaşlı sayılması.
Kılıç namlusu veya kabzadaki bir parçanın aynı adla anılması ve bunun eskiliğe bağlanmasının kesin olmaması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insanın ileri yaşını ve yaşlanma sürecini ortak biçimde verir; yıllanmış içki eskilik uzantısıdır. Kılıç parçasına ilişkin adlandırma sabittir, ancak bu adın eskilikten geldiği açıklaması kesin değildir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsandaki ileri yaş çekirdeğini ve bundan nesnelere uzanan eskilik nitelemesini birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan yaşlılığını, yaşlanmayı ve eskilik üzerinden kurulan ad aktarımını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanın veya başka bir şeyin arka bölümünü temel alır; işlerin sonları ve develerin arka kısımları bu uzamın doğal genişlemeleridir. Kadının kalçası, kalçanın iri olması, devenin arkasına binme ve kalçayı iri gösteren dolgu da aynı arka bölüm çekirdeğine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın veya başka bir varlığın arka kısmı ve işlerin son bölümü. Bu konumdan kadının kalçası ve iriliği, devenin arka tarafına binme ve kalçayı iri gösteren dolgu gibi özel kullanımlar gelişir.

facets.statement: İnsanın veya herhangi bir şeyin önün karşısındaki arka bölümü.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız belirli kum adlandırmalarını verir: dağ gibi yükselen fakat gevşek bir yığın olmayan kum sırtı, bitki yetişmesine elverişli yüksek kum oluşumu ve belirli bir çöl yöresindeki özel adlı kum tepesi. Arka beden benzerliği açıklayıcıdır, genel arka bölüm anlamı değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnız verilen kum söz öbekleriyle sınırlıdır; her kum tepesi veya her yüksek arazi için genel bir ad sayılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kaynakta verilen kum söz öbeklerine bağlanır ve bu kullanımlardan yalın kök için genel bir arazi anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz öbeklerinde, dağ gibi yükselen fakat gevşekçe yığılmış olmayan, bitki yetişmesine elverişli kum sırtı veya yüksek kum tepesi. Aynı adlandırma belirli bir çöl yöresindeki özel adlı bir kum tepesi için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Yalnız belirli kum söz öbeğinde dağ gibi yükselen kum sırtı veya kum tepesi.
Gevşek bir kum yığını olmayan ve bitki yetişmesine elverişli yüksek oluşum.
Belirli bir çöl yöresinde özel adla anılan kum tepesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yüksek kum sırtı veya tepesi niteliğinde birleşir; bazı ayrıntılar bunun gevşek bir yığın olmadığını ve bitki yetişmesine elverişli olduğunu belirtir. Ayrıca belirli bir yöredeki özel adlı kum tepesi de aynı toplu kanıtta yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir belirti ya da hastalık değil, hayvan ve kuşların arka bölümüne ilişkin üç ayrı kalıplaşmış kullanımı bir araya getirir: binek hayvanının arkasını tutan hastalık, kartala verilen tartışmalı niteleme ve kuşun arka parmağının adı. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu ayrımlar tek bir ortak belirti gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Hastalık, kartal niteliği ve kuşun arka parmağı ayrı söz öbeklerine bağlıdır; birinin özellikleri ötekine aktarılamaz.

concept_map.definition: Hayvanların arka bölümüne ilişkin üç ayrı kalıplaşmış adlandırma: binek hayvanının arka kısmını tutup onu ağırlaştıran hastalık, yorumu kaynaklara göre değişen bir kartal niteliği ve kuşun arka parmağı. Kartal niteliği hafif arka bölüm, güçlü arka parmak veya pençe, kısa kuyruk ya da kuyruktaki bir iki beyaz tüy biçiminde açıklanır.

facets.statement: Binek hayvanının arka kısmını tutarak hareketini ağırlaştıran hastalık.
Kartalın hafif arka bölümü, güçlü arka parmağı veya pençesi, kısa kuyruğu ya da kuyruğundaki bir iki beyaz tüyle açıklanan tartışmalı nitelik.
Kuşun geriye dönük arka parmağına verilen ad.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt hayvanın arka bölgesi çevresinde üç kalıplaşmış kullanımı birleştirir. Hastalık ve arka parmak açıkça ayrılır; kartal nitelemesinin hafif arka bölüm, güçlü arka parmak veya pençe, kısa kuyruk ya da beyaz kuyruk tüyü olarak açıklanmasında görüş ayrılığı vardır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın hastalığı binek hayvanının arka kısmındadır; komşu dal koyunun sırtındaki hastalıktır ve kuşlara ilişkin kullanımları yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Arka kısmı tutan hastalık ile kartal ve kuş parmağı adlandırmalarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Devenin sırt omurlarındaki bozukluğu veya kalçalarındaki ağırlık yüzünden kalkamamasını niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal hayvanın sırt veya kalça çevresindeki bozukluk ve ağırlık alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal doğrudan devedeki yapısal kusuru niteler; odak dalın hastalık kullanımı daha genel bir binek hayvanının arka kısmını tutan rahatsızlıktır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kuşun geriye dönük parmağını ve başka arka bölüm kullanımlarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: At veya başka bir binek hayvanında tırnak beyazlığını ve bacak kemiklerinin birleşme yerini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hayvan ayağındaki belirli anatomik parçaları veya işaretleri adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kuşun arka parmağına yönelir; komşu dal binek hayvanının tırnak rengi ve bacak birleşim yeriyle ilgilidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; hastalık, arka gövde kusuru ve ayak parçası alanlarında gerçek sınır karşılaştırması sağlayan üç komşu yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir erkeğin, kadının veya anne babanın çocukları arasındaki son çocuğu adlandırır. Anne babanın ileri yaşında doğmuş olma bazı tanıklarda özel bir vurgu olarak bulunur; son çocuk çekirdeği için her kullanımda zorunlu koşul değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çocuklar arasındaki son çocukla sınırlıdır; ileri yaştaki ebeveynden doğma yalnız özel vurgu olabilir, yaşlı kişinin kendisini veya herhangi bir dizinin sonunu anlatmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yerleşik son çocuk anlamını ileri yaştaki ebeveynden doğma vurgusu taşıyan özel kullanımdan ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir erkeğin, kadının veya anne babanın çocukları arasındaki son çocuk. Anne babası ileri yaştayken doğmuş olması bazı kullanımlarda özel bir vurgu olarak bulunur.

facets.statement: Bir erkeğin, kadının veya anne babanın çocukları arasındaki son çocuk.
Anne babası ileri yaşa geldikten sonra doğmuş olan son çocuk.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar son çocuk olma üzerinde birleşir; bazı tanıklıklar bunu yaşlı erkek, yaşlı kadın ya da ileri yaştaki iki ebeveyn üzerinden ayrıca özelleştirir. İleri yaşta doğmuş olma, bütün kullanımların belirleyici koşulu değil bazı kaynaklarda öne çıkan özel vurgudur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Anne veya babanın ileri yaşında dünyaya gelen ve kardeşler arasında son sırada bulunan çocuğu karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Çocuk katılımcısını, son sırayı ve ebeveynlerin ileri yaşı koşulunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ebeveynlerin ileri yaşı bağlamdan zaten belliyken kardeşler arasındaki son sırayı doğal biçimde anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Aile ilişkisini ve kardeşler arasındaki son çocuk olmayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Ebeveynlerin ileri yaşında doğmuş olma koşulunu tek başına belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Son sırayı ve ebeveynlerin ileri yaşını açıkça belirtmek gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ebeveynleri, ileri yaş koşulunu ve son çocuk olmayı eksiksiz korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yaşlı anne veya babanın son çocuğu

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çocuğun kardeşler arasında son olması çekirdeğini ve bazı kullanımlarda anne babasının ileri yaşında doğması vurgusunu taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çocuğu ve kuşakların birbirinden üremesini genel olarak, sıra veya ebeveyn yaşı koşulu olmadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal çocuk ve anne babadan gelen soy ilişkisi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal her türlü çocuk ve çoğalmayı kapsar; odak dal çocuklar arasındaki son çocuğu adlandırır ve bazı kullanımlarda ileri yaştaki ebeveyn vurgusu taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan ailesinde son sırayı belirleyici yapar; ebeveynlerin ileri yaşı bazı kullanımlarda özel vurgudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvan yavrusunun annesini izlemesini veya yavruların annelerine bağlı ilerlemesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal çocuk ya da yavrunun anneyle ilişkisini ve ardından gelme düşüncesini paylaşabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğum sırasındaki sonluğu bildirir; komşu dal ise doğmuş yavrunun annesini fiziksel olarak izlemesine odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çocuğun doğum sırasındaki sonluğunu ve bazı kullanımlarda doğduğu sırada ebeveynlerin ileri yaşını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çocuğun büyüyerek babasıyla arkadaş sayılabilecek yaşa gelmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal ebeveyn ile çocuk arasındaki ilişkinin yaşa bağlı bir görünümünü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ebeveynin yaşı ve çocuğun doğum sırasıyla ilgilidir; komşu dal çocuğun sonradan yetişkinliğe erişmesini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel çocuk kavramı, anne ardınca gelme ve çocuğun büyümesiyle yaş ilişkisini ayıran üç karşılaştırma seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan ve üzerinde yaşanan yeri temel anlam olarak verir; nesnelerin yere bakan altı ile hayvan ayağının alt bölümü de buna bağlı kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel yer anlamı ile yalnız tamlamalarda beliren alt bölüm ve hayvan ayağı anlamları birbirinden ayrılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yer anlamını kapsar; alt bölüm ve hayvan ayağı anlamlarını ise yalnız belirtilen tamlamalara bağlı yan yüzler olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan, üzerinde yaşadığımız yer küresini belirtir. Belirli tamlamalarda bir şeyin yere bakan altını ve hayvanın tırnağını ya da ayağının alt bölümünü de anlatır.

facets.statement: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan ve üzerinde yaşanan yer küresidir.
Bir şeyin yere bakan alt bölümü, belirli bir tamlama içinde bu adla anılır.
Hayvanın tırnağı veya ayağının yere değen alt bölümü için kullanılan özel bir tamlama vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamın merkezinde göğün karşısındaki aşağı yerin bulunduğunu; alt bölüm ve hayvan ayağı kullanımlarının bu mekansal çekirdeğe dayandığını birlikte gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: yer ve yere bakan alt bölüm
concept_gloss.applicability: Yer küresi anlamını ve ona bağlı alt bölüm yönelimini birlikte özetleyen en kısa doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Aşağıda olma, göğe karşıt konum ve yere bakan alt bölüm ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzerinde yaşanan ve göğün karşısında bulunan yer küresi söz konusu olduğunda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Üzerinde yaşanan aşağı yer ve göğe karşıt konum anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Nesnelerin altı ile hayvan ayağının alt bölümüne bağlı kullanımları dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Göğün karşısındaki yer küresini ve tamlamalardaki alt bölüm anlamlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Geniş ve düz araziyi, ayrıca serilip yayılan eşyayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yayılmış bir yüzey olarak yer alanına dokunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği aşağıda ve göğün karşısında bulunan yerdir; komşu dal ise yüzeyin genişliği ve düzlüğü ile serilmiş eşya fikrini öne çıkarır.
